title: The complete graph on an even number of vertices is 1-factorable
statement: For every natural number $n$, the complete graph $K_{2n}$ on $2n$ vertices is $1$-factorable; that is, its edge set can be partitioned into edge-disjoint $1$-factors.
hypotheses_covered: the graph is the complete graph on the $2n$-element vertex set $\mathrm{Fin}(2n)$
replaced:
